children: Dynex Capital entered into an Underwriting Agreement to issue 4,800,000 shares of 9.375% Series D Fixed-Rate Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, with a 30-day option for 720,000 additional shares. Net proceeds are expected to be approximately $116.2 million before expenses, with closing anticipated on or about September 29, 2026. The preferred shares carry a $25.00 liquidation preference. The deal is intended to bolster liquidity and support corporate needs.
: Underwriting agreement for public offering of 9.375% Series D preferred stock
: Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, RBC Capital Markets, UBS Securities, Wells Fargo Securities, Citigroup Global Markets, Goldman Sachs, Keefe, Bruyette & Woods, as representatives of the underwriters
